{{Top|ca|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''alien obelisk''' existed on the astronomical object [[Syned One]],<ref name="The Syned Conjunction">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Syned Conjunction}}</ref> located in the the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Syned system/Legends|Syned system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Syned system/Legends|Syned system]]</ref> Every six hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the alignment of the [[Star/Legends|stars]] would make the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] obelisk reveal strange inscriptions on its surface.<ref name="The Syned Conjunction" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Syned Conjunction" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the phenomenon took place again.<ref name="The Syned Conjunction" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to observe the inscriptions on the obelisk be revealed. The companion deciphered a map from the obelisk that led them to a strange discovery.<ref name="The Syned Conjunction" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The obelisk was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' within the Crew Skill Mission "The Syned Conjuction," though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="The Syned Conjunction" />
